messages:
lia (PM): Ok team — we need to finalize facilitators and the lightweight agenda for the annual planning offsite. Can people confirm availability and any must-have agenda items by EOD Thursday?

owen (Eng): I can take the throughput/cost tradeoffs session (30m) and the infra constraints Q&A (20m). Prefer morning slot.

maria (Design): Happy to lead customer journey mapping breakout. Will prepare a 15-min template and a 30-min working session.

kevin (Ops): Heads up — venue AV can support a single Zoom room + 2 breakout rooms hybrid. We need a list of remote-only attendees by next Tue for bandwidth checks.

steph (People Ops): Travel stipend/policy reminder: domestic travel covered up to $600, international handled case-by-case. Please submit travel intents by next Monday. Also collecting dietary restrictions — send me a quick DM.

lia (PM): Proposed high-level schedule snippet: ```09:00-09:30 Welcome + company context; 09:30-10:15 OKR & cross-team goals; 10:15-10:30 Break; 10:30-11:30 Breakouts (3x); 11:30-12:00 Synthesise; Lunch; 13:00-15:30 Deep-dive initiatives; 15:30-16:00 Wrap & action owners``` Thoughts?

raj (Data): Can we add a short 10-min metrics baseline at start of OKR block — just to ground decisions? I can prepare slides with current latency/cost & growth signals.

lia (PM): Yes — raj add 10 min. Also we need breakout owners: design = maria, infra = owen, product discovery = ???

maria (Design): I nominate ash (Product) for discovery owner — ash is leading the new evals work. ash, you good?

kevin (Ops): For hybrid: calendar-bot, can we lock rooms A/B and book a Zoom room with mics in each?

calendar-bot: Rooms A/B booked for 2026-05-12 09:00-17:00. Zoom link created. Attendee list required by 2026-05-05.

lia (PM): Great. Action list I'm writing down: 1) Lia to publish final agenda by Fri; 2) Raj to prep metrics baseline slide (due Thu); 3) Owen + Maria to prep breakout prompts & deliverables (due Mon); 4) Steph to collect travel & dietary info (due Mon); 5) Kevin to confirm AV test schedule (tests Wed before event).

owen (Eng): I'll drop a short facilitator guide in the thread — 3 prompts, timekeeper + scribe roles.

lia (PM): Also quick ask — any strong takes on focus: prioritize reliability/cost optimizations OR product velocity initiatives? We'll use a short vote during the OKR block but want folks to come prepared.

maria (Design): Leaning product velocity but include a slice of cost targets tied to SLOs.

lia (PM): Thanks. Final ask: pre-reads list — please add one doc each (max 2 pages) to this thread by next Tue. We'll publish a single packet.

kevin (Ops): Noted. I'll post the AV test checklist & remote attendee runbook in this thread by Friday.

lia (PM): Thanks all — if nobody objects I'll lock the agenda Friday lunchtime and @channels the pre-read deadline. :white_check_mark:

steph (People Ops): No objections from me.

maria (Design): Fine from design.

owen (Eng): Good from infra.

lia (PM): Locking plan then. I'll send final agenda + action item tracker tomorrow morning.
